status: external inputs; fetched and hash-checked by fetch_limb_inputs.py; ignored by Git
publication_note: X-ray and extreme-ultraviolet absorption of air, and the solar cycle of the X-rays, for limb_heat.py: the CXRO atomic scattering factor tables (Henke, Gullikson and Davis 1993), the Leiden photodissociation and photoionization database, which asks users to cite Heays, Bosman and van Dishoeck (2017) and the measurements behind each cross section, and FISM2 daily spectra from LASP (Chamberlin et al. 2020). The files are not redistributed by this repository. A hash mismatch means the upstream bytes changed and must be reviewed, never silently accepted.

files.name: n.nff
files.credit: Nitrogen atomic scattering factors, 10 eV-30 keV: Henke, Gullikson and Davis (1993), At. Data Nucl. Data Tables 54, 181-342, via the CXRO tables at henke.lbl.gov.
files.use: X-ray photoabsorption of air along slant paths (limb_heat)

files.name: o.nff
files.credit: Oxygen atomic scattering factors, 10 eV-30 keV: Henke, Gullikson and Davis (1993), via the CXRO tables; the same bytes as the protection domain's copy.
files.use: X-ray photoabsorption of air along slant paths (limb_heat)

files.name: N2_0.1nm.txt
files.credit: N2 photoabsorption continuum, 11.6-100 nm, resampled to 0.1 nm: Leiden database for photodissociation and photoionization (Heays, Bosman and van Dishoeck 2017, A&A 602, A105), with the measurements it cites.
files.use: Extreme-ultraviolet absorption of air along slant paths (limb_heat)

files.name: O2_0.1nm.txt
files.credit: O2 photoabsorption, 4.2-240 nm, resampled to 0.1 nm: Leiden database for photodissociation and photoionization (Heays, Bosman and van Dishoeck 2017, A&A 602, A105), with the measurements it cites.
files.use: Extreme- and far-ultraviolet absorption of air along slant paths (limb_heat)

files.name: O_0.1nm.txt
files.credit: O photoabsorption, 4.9-91 nm, resampled to 0.1 nm: Leiden database for photodissociation and photoionization (Heays, Bosman and van Dishoeck 2017, A&A 602, A105), with the measurements it cites.
files.use: Extreme-ultraviolet absorption of atomic oxygen along slant paths (limb_heat)

files.name: fism2_xray_2008-04-10_2008-04-16.csv
files.credit: FISM2 daily solar spectral irradiance, 0.1 nm bins below 10 nm, the WHI 2008 quiet-Sun campaign, 10-16 April 2008: the Flare Irradiance Spectral Model, version 2 (Chamberlin et al. 2020, Space Weather 18, e2020SW002588), via LASP's LISIRD data centre (lasp.colorado.edu/lisird). A LaTiS query; its bytes are those of the model version current when retrieved.
files.use: Solar-cycle factor of the X-rays the films and gaps pass (limb_heat): the quiet week the solar-cycle factors divide by
